description: This file contains the main React Native component for a Tic Tac Toe game, including UI components, game logic, state management, and interactions for modes, scoring, and game control.

methods.name: emptyBoard
methods.description: Creates a new empty game board, an array of 9 nulls.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner on the board, returning the winner and winning line if any.

methods.name: isBoardFull
methods.description: Checks if all cells in the board are filled, indicating a draw if no winner.

methods.name: chooseBestMove
methods.description: Simple AI algorithm to select the best move: winning move, blocking move, center, corner, side.
